description: Repeated groups, exact key column names, whole-group bounds and tagged continuation.

families.repeated/boundaries: Inclusive and exclusive seeks at every group key, plus exact-group lookups and prefix reads
families.repeated/pagination: Every page size 1, 2, 5, 7; row cursors resume inside groups, prefix cursors skip rollups
families.repeated/cursor-every-row: A row cursor at every row of the repeated layouts, limit 6: resumption at every page, row-group, group and part boundary, with group offsets counted across row groups
families.repeated/invalid-cursors: Malformed tags, offsets and base64 are rejected
